Summarise stacked quality scores per run

Source: R/compare-runs.R
summarise_runs.Rd

Condenses the output of compare_runs() to one row per (run, metric): the number of samples with a value, the median and the inter-quartile range, plus the number of samples per traffic-light category of the run.

Usage

summarise_runs(runs_tbl, metrics = NULL)

Arguments

runs_tbl

Output of compare_runs().

metrics

Metric columns to summarise. Default: composite_score and every raw metric of quality_thresholds_default() present in runs_tbl.

Value

A data frame with columns Run, metric, label, n, median, q25, q75, n_Pass, n_Warning, n_Fail.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summarise_runs(compare_runs(c("3_results/dda_jy", "3_results/dda_plasma")))
} # }
